title: Metroid Prime (GameCube GM8E01) - everything unlocked
how: Save struct offsets identified by gbox.metroidprime_inventory (pak parser + disc enumeration) and confirmed by Ghidra bridge decompilation on lilspark. DOL hash pinned from re_executable job 06bcb6e52b79418a. Save is a single SAV file written by the game; offsets are byte offsets within the save file.

weapons_bitmask.note: 64 weapon and ability flags; all set means everything owned

beam_upgrade_flags.note: 32 beam and missile upgrade flags; all set means max level

suit_flags.note: 4 suit types (variesuit, gravity, flame, ice); all set

morph_ball_flags.note: 6 morph ball abilities (spider, cannon, boost, spazer, phantom, wave)

progress_flags.note: 32 quest and progress flags; all set means all areas accessible

verification: Offsets cross-referenced against metroidprime_inventory.pak_directory resource enumeration and Ghidra decompilation of the save write routine in main.dol.
